Questions business owners ask

I only have an idea. Can you still help?

Yes. Many projects start as a rough idea. We help you shape it into a clear plan and a first version.

How much does an app cost?

It depends on features and platforms. After a short call you’ll get a written quote showing what’s included.

How long does it take to build?

A focused first version usually takes a few months. Larger apps take longer. You get a timeline in the plan.

Android, iOS or both?

If you’re unsure, we’ll recommend based on your customers. A cross-platform app covers both with one build.

Will my app be on the Play Store and App Store?

Yes. We prepare and submit it. The stores review every app, so approval timing is up to them.

Do I own the app?

Yes. The app, its code and your customer data belong to you.

Can the app connect to my existing systems?

Usually, yes. We can connect payments, WhatsApp, billing and other tools you already use.

What if I want changes later?

You can add features any time, or choose a support plan so updates are handled for you.
